summary: CSV importer backend. Reads CSV via Polars, infers dimension columns (everything except rule_name and aggregate columns), maps Polars dtypes to Python types, and constructs a Lattice with DimensionsMetadata. All dimensions default to EXACT match strategy.
lifecycle_notes: Registered via entry point: mountainash_babel.importers: csv
All imported dimensions use MatchStrategy.EXACT — fidelity lost for other strategies
documentation_hooks: Limitation: all dimensions import as EXACT
examples: docs/quickstart.md — import_lattice with dimension_columns and aggregate_columns
risks: Match strategy always set to EXACT — round-tripping through CSV loses RANGE/SET/PREFIX/etc. strategies

evidence.detail: Tests CSV import with various column configurations
